sources.title: Brane nucleation instabilities in non-AdS/non-CFT

evidence.text: Does a supersymmetry- and conformal-symmetry-breaking deformation of finite-density Klebanov–Witten theory retain low-temperature brane nucleation instabilities, and what bearing might these have on the proposed absence of disordered zero-temperature holographic phases?

sources.title: Tachyonic Kaluza-Klein modes and the AdS swampland conjecture

evidence.text: Does the non-supersymmetric SO(3) × SO(3)-invariant AdS4 vacuum, stable within four-dimensional N = 8 supergravity, acquire perturbative instabilities from higher Kaluza-Klein modes after uplift to eleven dimensions?

sources.title: Stable Nonsupersymmetric Anti–de Sitter Vacua of Massive IIA Supergravity

evidence.text: Are the seven nonsupersymmetric AdS4 vacua of maximal ISO(7) gauged supergravity stable against higher-dimensional Kaluza–Klein fluctuations after uplift to massive IIA, and how do their stability properties bear on the nonsupersymmetric AdS Swampland Conjecture?

sources.title: Compactifications of String/M-Theory and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can the right-squashed, nonsupersymmetric AdS4 vacuum develop a tadpole instability associated with a global singlet marginal operator (GSMO)? The thesis seeks sufficiently detailed Kaluza–Klein masses to identify elementary or composite fields that could support this mechanism.

sources.title: Charge instability of JMaRT geometries

evidence.text: Do JMaRT geometries admit unstable scalar modes carrying nonzero Kaluza–Klein momentum even with zero angular harmonic number, beyond the near-decoupling limit, and can these modes describe charge loss?

sources.title: Slow-Roll Inflation in Non-geometric Flux Compactification

evidence.text: Which constrained integer-flux configurations yield stable non-supersymmetric dS or AdS extrema in an isotropic type IIB non-geometric model, and do the reported dS examples admit small-field, multi-field slow-roll conditions?

sources.title: More stable de Sitter vacua from S-dual nongeometric fluxes

evidence.text: Can S-dual nongeometric P-fluxes and torus anisotropy produce further stable dS/AdS candidates, remove instabilities hidden by isotropic truncations, and change the moduli hierarchies relevant to small-field inflation?

sources.title: A swamp of non-SUSY vacua

evidence.text: Do known massive-IIA non-supersymmetric AdS vacua that appear stable in closed-string truncations become unstable after including open-string degrees of freedom on their supporting D6-branes?

sources.title: Modular symmetries and the swampland conjectures

evidence.text: Do the nonsupersymmetric AdS local minima admit a nonperturbative decay compatible with the conjecture excluding stable nonsupersymmetric AdS vacua?

sources.title: Brane annihilation in non-supersymmetric strings

evidence.text: Do non-supersymmetric string AdS flux vacua decay nonperturbatively toward smaller flux, and can vacuum bubbles, probe dynamics, and near-horizon geometries support a microscopic brane-annihilation interpretation?

sources.title: Brane-Jet Instabilities

evidence.text: Can localized fundamental-brane probes expose decay channels of nonsupersymmetric AdS vacua that are invisible within gauged maximal supergravity, especially the SO(3)×SO(3)-invariant AdS4 vacuum?

sources.title: The non-SUSY AdS$_{6}$ and AdS$_{7}$ fixed points are brane-jet unstable

evidence.text: Do the non-supersymmetric AdS6 and AdS7 fixed points exhibit repulsive probe-brane forces, and hence the proposed brane-jet instability, in their massive-IIA and eleven-dimensional uplifts?

sources.title: On the stability of AdS backgrounds with λ-deformed factors

evidence.text: Which previously constructed nonsupersymmetric type-IIB backgrounds with unwarped AdS_3, AdS_4 or AdS_6 factors exhibit perturbative instabilities in a reduced gravity–scalar analysis, and which parameter regions survive that test?

sources.title: Non-supersymmetric AdS$_{6}$ and the swampland

evidence.text: Do bent 5-brane domain-wall profiles indicate a decay of a non-supersymmetric AdS6 vacuum?

sources.title: Non-supersymmetric AdS$_{6}$ and the swampland

evidence.text: Do backreacted seven-brane punctures alter the D7 fluctuation spectrum found in unpunctured AdS6 examples?

sources.title: Bubble instability of mIIA on $\mathrm{AdS}_4\times S^6$

evidence.text: Does the non-supersymmetric G₂-invariant AdS₄×S⁶ vacuum of massive IIA admit a nonperturbative decay channel despite its reported perturbative and brane-jet stability?

sources.title: BIonic membranes and AdS instabilities

evidence.text: Can wrapped D-brane membranes produce non-perturbative decays of perturbatively stable, non-supersymmetric AdS4 flux vacua once curvature effects and localization of D6/O6 sources are included?

sources.title: Brane-jet stabilities from Janus and Sasaki-Einstein

evidence.text: Do selected non-supersymmetric Janus and Sasaki–Einstein AdS backgrounds exhibit repulsive probe-brane forces, and can brane-jet tests be extended from flat domain walls to curved AdS-sliced domain walls?

sources.title: On the stability of string theory vacua

evidence.text: Can vacuum stability be established directly in ten- or eleven-dimensional supergravity, including localized branes and decay channels inaccessible to a lower-dimensional truncation? Can the resulting spinorial positivity argument protect non-supersymmetric vacua?

sources.title: A weakly non-abelian decay channel

evidence.text: Can weakly non-abelian D-brane stacks open decay channels for AdS flux vacua that resist abelian domain-wall nucleation, and what background conditions permit such stacks?

sources.title: Instability of the Kaluza-Klein vacuum

evidence.text: Is the original Kaluza–Klein vacuum classically and semiclassically stable, and how do energy positivity, allowed spacetime topologies, and elementary fermions affect that assessment?

sources.title: Slow-Roll Inflation in Non-geometric Flux Compactification

evidence.text: Integer flux configurations satisfying R-R tadpole, T-dual tadpole and Q·H3=Q·Q=0 Bianchi constraints are generated before numerical minimisation. A genetic algorithm searches the six real moduli with stated convergence criterion 10^-20 and a finite flux cutoff.

sources.title: More stable de Sitter vacua from S-dual nongeometric fluxes

evidence.text: The displayed superpotential is W=P₀−SP₁+Σm(P₂m−SP₃m)Um, with cubic polynomials in the complex-structure fields and coefficients determined by fluxes. The Kähler potential is K=−Σi=1⁷ln(2ψi). Numerical mass matrices, F-terms and gravitino quantities characterize the candidates.

sources.title: A swamp of non-SUSY vacua

evidence.text: In four dimensions, extend the N=4 theory from six to 6+N vector multiplets, adding 3N position and 3N Yang–Mills scalars, and compute spectra using the embedding-tensor scalar potential.

sources.title: Modular symmetries and the swampland conjectures

evidence.text: Determine the modular covariance of the superpotential from the Kähler transformation, represent the allowed sections through modular forms, and analyze their cusp expansions and extrema.

sources.title: Brane annihilation in non-supersymmetric strings

evidence.text: Sphere reduction with a dynamical radion produces a lower-dimensional Einstein-frame vacuum energy. Euclidean thin-wall instantons compare bubble area and enclosed-volume contributions to B in Γ/Vol∼(det)e^(−B).

sources.title: Brane nucleation instabilities in non-AdS/non-CFT

evidence.text: A consistent five-dimensional truncation reduces the radial background equations to four first-order and four second-order equations. Double-sided shooting matches horizon and boundary expansions at an interior point, using Mathematica FindRoot.

sources.title: Type IIB S-folds: flat deformations, holography and stability

evidence.text: How do flat deformations of type IIB S-folds encode marginal deformations holographically, change global geometry and supersymmetry, and affect stability when supersymmetry is fully broken?

sources.title: Chiral Supergravity

evidence.text: Can chiral gravity be extended supersymmetrically, with explicit gravitino modes and conserved charges demonstrating chirality and perturbative AdS3 stability under suitable boundary conditions?

sources.title: The complete Kaluza-Klein spectra of $ \mathcal{N} $ = 1 and $ \mathcal{N} $ = 0 M-theory on AdS$_{4}$× (squashed S$^{7}$)

evidence.text: Complete the squashed-S7 Kaluza–Klein operator spectra, assign AdS4 masses and energies to the supersymmetric and skew-whiffed compactifications, and determine how boundary conditions affect possible scalar singlet marginal operators.

sources.title: Positive energy and non-SUSY flows in ISO(7) gauged supergravity

evidence.text: Can Hamilton–Jacobi methods establish positive-energy protection for non-supersymmetric AdS extrema within the G₂-invariant ISO(7) truncation, construct interpolating flat domain walls, and provide a method for curved flows?

sources.title: More on Massive 3D Supergravity

evidence.text: Can cosmological NMG and GMG arise as genuine bosonic truncations of N = 1 supergravity, which AdS vacua are supersymmetric, and under what conditions are their linearized excitations perturbatively unitary?

sources.title: On new maximal supergravity and its BPS domain-walls

evidence.text: What are the scalar potential, fermion couplings and superpotentials of the SU(3)-invariant sector of dyonic SO(8) maximal supergravity, and what do they imply for nonsupersymmetric AdS stability and BPS domain walls?

sources.title: Charting the conformal manifold of holographic CFT$_2$'s

evidence.text: Which continuous deformations of AdS3×S3×T4 and AdS3×S3×S3×S1 can be constructed uniformly in heterotic and type II supergravity, what are their Kaluza–Klein spectra and perturbative stability properties, and how should their worldsheet and holographic operators be interpreted?

sources.title: Spectrum and stability of compactifications on product manifolds

evidence.text: What is the complete linearized spectrum and perturbative stability of Freund–Rubin compactifications when a q-form individually wraps each of N internal Einstein factors, including factors with unequal flux densities?

sources.title: De-Higgsing in eleven-dimensional supergravity on the squashed S $^{7}$

evidence.text: How do the Sp(1) × Sp(2) singlet modes and their AdS4 fields change between round, left-squashed and right-squashed S7 compactifications, especially through Rarita–Schwinger consistency, de-Higgsing and boundary-condition choices relevant to stability?

sources.title: Vacua of maximal gauged D = 3 supergravities

evidence.text: Which vacua occur in semisimple maximal three-dimensional gauged supergravities, what supersymmetries and fluctuation spectra do they possess, and how do their stability patterns differ from higher-dimensional examples?

sources.title: Searching for Coleman–de Luccia bubbles in AdS compactifications

evidence.text: Can Hamilton–Jacobi flows construct smooth, fully backreacted dS-sliced walls between supersymmetric and non-supersymmetric AdS vacua with string/M-theory uplifts, providing candidate Coleman–de Luccia bubbles beyond the thin-wall approximation?

sources.title: New Supersymmetric and Stable, Non-Supersymmetric Phases in Supergravity and Holographic Field Theory

evidence.text: Can numerically discovered AdS critical points of four-dimensional maximal gauged supergravity be characterized analytically, connected by supersymmetric holographic flows, and tested for stability against the full scalar spectrum, including modes outside small truncations?

sources.title: Magnetic $AdS \times \mathbb R^2$: Supersymmetry and stability

evidence.text: Can a background Kaluza–Klein magnetic field produce a controlled lower-dimensional holographic IR theory, and which supersymmetric or nonsupersymmetric embeddings avoid magnetic, Coulomb-branch and other instabilities?

sources.title: Non-SUSY DW’s in ISO(7) gauged supergravity

evidence.text: Can fake-supergravity Hamilton–Jacobi flows construct nonsupersymmetric domain walls between AdS extrema of the SU(3)-invariant ISO(7) theory, and can their properties support a conditional DW/QFT interpretation that tests the non-SUSY AdS conjecture?

sources.title: Kaluza-Klein Supergravity 2025

evidence.text: What do eleven-dimensional supergravity compactifications, especially round and squashed seven-spheres, teach about surviving supersymmetry, gauge symmetry, vacuum stability, consistent truncations and complete Kaluza–Klein spectra? This is a retrospective review with updates on spectral methods.

sources.title: Squashed 7-spheres, octonions and the swampland

evidence.text: How do operator spectra on squashed S7 determine AdS4 masses and supersymmetry multiplets, and what do orientation reversal, boundary conditions and singletons imply for the nonsupersymmetric AdS stability question?

sources.title: A cornucopia of AdS$_{5}$ vacua

evidence.text: Which AdS5 critical points occur in five-dimensional maximal SO(6) gauged supergravity, what supersymmetry and scalar stability do they have, and how many can be captured by tractable consistent truncations?

What are their KK spectra, deformation operators and tested decay channels?

sources.title: On the stability and spectrum of non-supersymmetric AdS(5) solutions of M-theory compactified on Kahler-Einstein spaces

evidence.text: Which nonsupersymmetric AdS5×M6 compactifications on positive Kähler-Einstein six-manifolds are stable against linearized bosonic supergravity perturbations, and what do their KK spectrum, M5 nucleation channel and neutral massless scalars imply for possible instabilities?

evidence.text: Local f is Taylor-expanded about an AdS extremum with f^(0)=√(−V_0/3) and f^(1)=0. The authors describe 2^4=16 Hessian branches, followed by linear equations for higher coefficients. Low-Hessian branches generate candidate interpolating walls; high-Hessian branches are used for bounding functions.

sources.title: Anti-de Sitter vacua of gauged supergravities with eight supercharges

evidence.text: Use the D=5 attractor condition α_I proportional to X_I, expressing normality to the cubic hypersurface, and special-geometry Hessian identities at supersymmetric critical points to classify extrema and argue for their separation.

sources.title: New formulations of D = 10 supersymmetry and D8 - O8 domain walls

evidence.text: Derive wall profiles both from field/Killing-spinor equations and from a BPS-type energy functional. The latter contains one positive and one negative square, plus total derivatives and explicit source terms. The nine-form equation cancels the distributional source contribution, and vanishing square expressions yields first-order flow equations.
